name: tiny-tools

plugins.name: tiny-context
plugins.description: Know things about files without reading them: outline, ranked search, surgical reads, SQL over CSV/XLSX/Parquet, log clustering, diffs, validation and extraction — including PDF/DOCX/PPTX/XLSX. Eight MCP tools plus a skill that tells Claude when to reach for them. Local, deterministic, bounded responses with a token-savings line on every call.

plugins.name: tiny-runtime
plugins.description: Resumable API pagination and batch collection, repeated-failure analysis, and tool-progress cache hints for AI agents. Three MCP tools with selection guidance; automatic enforcement and GPU effects need host integration.
